Our Export Activities

Beninese agricultural supply chains, sourced, controlled and packaged for international markets.

Agri-food & Tropical Products

Export

Origin & selection · Adapted packaging · CIF / FOB on request

Export

Pineapple & Derivatives

Fresh pineapple, juice and dried fruit, graded and packaged for export.

Benin produces some of the world's finest pineapples, notably the Sugarloaf and Smooth Cayenne varieties, unique for their flavour and sweetness. BADSAL & FILS OKIKIOLA exports rigorously selected fresh pineapples, along with processed derivatives (juice, dried fruit) meeting the strictest international standards.

Export

Shea & Derivatives

Raw and refined shea butter, full traceability from the cooperatives.

A major player in the oilseed sector, we supply premium shea nuts as well as pure shea butter, raw or refined. Our products are sought after by global cosmetics and food industries for their richness and traceability.

Export

Cassava & Derivatives

Gari, tapioca and cassava flour processed to international standards.

Cassava is at the heart of our agricultural value strategy. We export cassava in several forms: fresh tubers, cassava powder (gari, fufu, etc.) and high-purity industrial starch for food and manufacturing applications.

Export

Palm Nut & Derivatives

Palm oil and derivatives from a responsible, controlled supply chain.

We collect and select the finest palm nuts for vegetable-oil extraction and the production of high-quality derivatives, intended for human consumption and industrial use.

Export

Cashew

Benin produces one of the world's most prized cashews for its excellent KOR yield. We export raw nuts and graded kernels, sorted and certified.

Benin produces one of the world's most prized cashews for its excellent KOR yield. Our vision goes beyond trading raw materials: we are structuring our value chain toward local processing. In addition to exporting rigorously sorted raw cashew nuts (RCN), we are building industrial capacity to supply shelled, graded, white or roasted kernels — a ready-to-use finished product compliant with the strictest international safety standards.

Export

Soy & Derivatives

Backed by 100% GMO-free national production, Beninese soy is a pillar of our offer: seeds, cake and oil destined for international markets.

Backed by 100% GMO-free national production, Beninese soy is a pillar of our industrial strategy. Beyond exporting raw seeds, we invest in crushing and local processing to supply raw or refined soybean oils and premium cake (in bulk or pellets) for animal feed — supply security across a complete range, from raw material to industrial product.

Export

Fresh Mango & Avocado

We export fresh mangoes and avocados, carefully selected and cold-chain packaged to preserve their full quality.

We export fresh mangoes and avocados, rigorously selected from Benin's finest orchards. Picked at an optimal stage of maturity for transport, our fruit guarantees exceptional freshness, texture and flavour on international markets.

Export

Sesame

Benin produces high-quality sesame, oil-rich, white and uniform, sorted and packaged to the requirements of international buyers.

Benin produces high-quality, oil-rich sesame. We supply raw sesame seeds, cleaned and sorted, meeting the strict requirements of the food, bakery and oil-extraction industries in Asia and Europe.

Export

Groundnut

Groundnut is central to our industrial diversification program: shelled seeds, oil and high-value cake.

Groundnut is central to our industrial diversification program. Beyond selecting edible seeds, we are moving toward crushing: premium groundnut oil sought for its culinary properties, and by-products valorized into protein-rich cake for feed manufacturers. A vertical integration that guarantees zero waste and end-to-end controlled quality.

Export

Pure Organic Honey

Our honey is harvested artisanally and responsibly from local beekeepers, ensuring a pure, natural and traceable product.

Our honey is harvested artisanally and responsibly in Benin's preserved areas. 100% pure, natural and certified organic, it stands out for its nutritional properties and rich aromas, sought after by the health and food sectors.

Export

Dried Fruits

To meet growing demand for healthy snacks, we offer dried pineapple, mango and banana with no additives or added sugar.

To meet growing demand for healthy snacks, we offer a premium range of dried fruits (pineapple, mango). With no added sugar or preservatives, our dehydration process preserves all the original flavours and vitamins.

Animal Feed

Export

Origin & selection · Adapted packaging · CIF / FOB on request

Export

Animal Feed

Soybean and cotton cake, pellets and Ud-Cake for breeders: protein-rich feed formulated for animal performance.

We are a strategic supplier of high-protein animal feed for breeders and feed manufacturers. Our catalogue includes soybean cake, cottonseed cake (in bulk or pellets) and Ud-Cake. These industrial co-products ensure optimal animal nutrition.

Mining Resources (Gold)

International trading of foundry gold and precious stones, in strict compliance with conformity and traceability standards.

BADSAL & FILS OKIKIOLA operates in the international trading of mining resources from the sub-region. We facilitate the export of foundry gold and rough precious stones, in strict compliance with international regulations, traceability processes and the most rigorous safety standards.
